content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer, files an appeal against the District Commission's order to pay Rs. 1 lakh to a seller. Rahul wants to appeal to the State Commission but has not deposited 50% of the ordered amount.
content.outcome: The State Commission will not entertain Rahul's appeal unless he deposits 50% of the ordered amount, i.e., Rs. 50,000, in the prescribed manner.

user_queries: What is the requirement for appealing to the State Commission?
Can I appeal without depositing 50% of the ordered amount?
What is the purpose of depositing 50% of the ordered amount?
